_note: All text players see for rp_starter. PLACEHOLDER TEXT: Liam will rewrite the arrival story and tour. Edit the words on the right side only. Keep every %s: the game fills those in. \n starts a new line. **bold** and - lists work in the big pop-ups.
title: New in town

volunteer.intro:
Long ride, huh? Welcome to the city. I volunteer here for the **Fresh Start** program. We help new arrivals get on their feet.

Here's what you've got:
- **$500 cash** in your pocket and **$2,500** in the bank
- A phone and your ID (press **TAB** to check your pockets)
- One **free used vehicle** from the program. Pick it right here.

After that, I'll point you around: the bank, a gas station, and City Hall for work. Then you're on your own. Good luck out there.

asea.label: Declasse Asea (sedan)
asea.desc: Four doors, cheap to run, nobody looks twice.

landstalker.label: Dundreary Landstalker (SUV)
landstalker.desc: Old but roomy. Good for hauling friends and stuff.

pcj.label: Shitzu PCJ-600 (motorcycle)
pcj.desc: Quick and nimble. Not much room for anything else.

chino.label: Vapid Chino (old muscle)
chino.desc: A classic with a big engine and bigger personality.

bobcatxl.label: Vapid Bobcat XL (truck)
bobcatxl.desc: An open-bed work truck. Honest and tough.

vehicle.confirm_text:
This is your **only** free vehicle, so choose well. It's yours to keep, but it **can't be sold or traded**.

It comes with about half a tank of gas.
vehicle.claimed: The %s is yours. Plate: %s. Park it in any garage when you're done driving.
vehicle.cant_sell: Free starter vehicles can't be sold or traded.

greet.text: Talk to the volunteer at the bus station (look at them and use your third eye).

vehicle.text: Pick your free vehicle from the volunteer.

kiosk.text: Grab some water or a snack at the kiosk next door. Hunger and thirst go down slowly.

bank.text: Head to the Fleeca bank on Legion Square. Your $2,500 is in there. Banks and ATMs work anywhere in the city.

fuel.text: Fill up at the gas station on Strawberry Ave. Gas is about $4.26 a gallon, so a full tank runs about $65.

cityhall.text: Stop by City Hall. That's where you find work and replace lost IDs. Tip: jobs pay more with friends. Type /crew to start a crew.
